data.promptProse: Orange LCL light surrounds adult Rei Ayanami floating alone inside a sealed culture tank. Completely nude, she draws both knees toward her chest and holds one thigh with a bandaged hand while the other fingers herself between her legs. Bubbles follow the motion across pale skin as interface cables remain distant and orderly. Short blue hair frames crimson eyes, flushed cheeks and the first signs of self-directed desire. Vertical submerged solo portrait, no text or extra people.
